findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "claimhit_get_result" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get results from a previous ClaimHit search by search ID, and narrow, sort and page through them. FREE and unlimited: every call is a view over results already …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
